== Old Info ==

The Citizens team has a IRC chat room on esper.net. You can join this room to receive support or make suggestions.

[http://webchat.esper.net/?channels=citizens Here] is a web-based link to the chat, or point your favorite IRC client to #citizens on irc.esper.net

The rules for chatting on our IRC room, #citizens, are listed below:

# No spamming, advertising, or soliciting.
# Please don't ping the OPs unnecessarily, they are likely coding the next great feature. Don't worry, they check in regularly!
# Don't ask to ask, just ask any question you may have.
# Read through [http://workaround.org/getting-help-on-irc this page] before chatting. It has lots of good tips.
# Stick around when asking a question, we're busy people but will get to you as soon as possible.
